method: daily close-to-close price returns, equal-weighted; baskets formed at the prior close: US-listed common stocks in the four equity books, close >= $5, 20-session dollar volume >= $5M, market cap >= $1B (today's), 260+ sessions; mom = 12-1 month top minus bottom fifth; rev = the week's bottom fifth minus its top fifth; beta = top minus bottom fifth of 252-session daily beta vs the benchmark, re-formed every 21 sessions; si = the 50 highest short interest as a share of shares outstanding (FINRA's latest settlement / the SEC count; Yahoo's short % of float only without FINRA coverage; used for the whole year) minus the average stock; z = (day - mean) / sd over 252 sessions; moves beyond +100 % / -50 % left out as data errors

labels.si: the most-shorted 50 vs the average stock
labels.rev: the week's losers minus its winners
